name: Great Outdoors Meeting
notes:
New location on the lawn - We've moved to the NorthEast corner of the Chautauqua Lawn.

Look for the yellow balloon.

Bring a blanket or chair to sit on. Bring water if it's hot.
Join us for a fellowship hike on the last Tuesday of the month. On the last Tuesday of the month, the meeting will end at 715PM and anyone interested can join us for a chill 20-30 minute hike up one of the trails.

If it's raining we will move the meeting to the porch of the Chautauqua Ranger Cottage.
